title: Selectors and combinators
summary: Target elements through types, classes, attributes, and structural relationships.
rules: A space matches descendants; > matches direct children.
Class selectors match class tokens; an id selector has higher specificity.

title: Cascade, inheritance and layers
summary: Resolve competing declarations using origin, importance, layers, specificity, and order.
rules: Specificity is compared after origin, importance, and cascade layer.
For normal author rules, unlayered declarations outrank layered declarations.
Layer order reverses for important declarations; avoid !important as a default strategy.

title: Box model and sizing
summary: Control content size, padding, border, and outside spacing.
syntax: .class { box-sizing: border-box; inline-size: length; padding: length; border: width style color; margin: length; }
rules: border-box includes padding and borders in the declared width or height.
Margins are outside the box; vertical block margins can collapse.
Logical inline/block properties adapt to writing direction.

title: Units and calculated values
summary: Express lengths relative to fonts, viewports, or containers and calculate bounded values.
syntax: .class { inline-size: calc(100% - 2rem); font-size: clamp(minimum, preferred, maximum); min-block-size: 100dvh; }
rules: rem uses the root font size; em depends on the relevant element font size.
Percentages resolve against a property-specific reference.
Use whitespace around + and - in calc expressions.

title: Colors and backgrounds
summary: Set foregrounds, backgrounds, transparency, and gradients.
syntax: .class { color: color; background-color: color; background-image: linear-gradient(direction, color, color); opacity: number; }
rules: color sets the foreground and is inherited; background properties usually are not.
opacity composites the entire element including its descendants.
Check text contrast and provide non-color status cues.

title: Typography and text flow
summary: Choose readable fonts, weights, line spacing, and text wrapping.
syntax: .class { font-family: family, fallback; font-size: length; font-weight: weight; line-height: number; text-align: start; }
rules: Provide a generic fallback when naming fonts.
A unitless line-height scales with each descendant font size.

title: Display and visibility
summary: Choose how a box participates in layout or whether it is rendered.
syntax: .class { display: block | inline | inline-block | flex | grid | none; visibility: visible | hidden; }
rules: display:none removes a box from layout and normally from accessibility APIs.
visibility:hidden preserves layout space.
Use the HTML hidden attribute for semantic hidden state where appropriate.

title: Flexbox alignment
summary: Arrange items along one main axis and align them on the cross axis.
syntax:
.container { display: flex; flex-direction: row | column; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: length; justify-content: value; align-items: value; }
.item { flex: grow shrink basis; }
rules: justify-content follows the main axis; align-items follows the cross axis.
Allow wrapping or shrinking for small screens; min-inline-size:0 can let text items shrink.

title: Grid layouts
summary: Lay out rows and columns with explicit tracks or responsive repetition.
syntax:
.container { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(count, minmax(minimum, 1fr)); gap: length; }
.item { grid-column: start / end; }
rules: fr divides remaining track space; minmax bounds a track.
auto-fit collapses empty repeated tracks; auto-fill preserves them.
Visual reordering does not change DOM reading or keyboard order.

title: Positioning and stacking
summary: Place boxes relative to normal flow, containing blocks, or scroll containers.
rules: Absolute positioning removes a box from normal flow and uses its containing block.
Sticky positioning needs an inset and is constrained by its scroll container.
z-index values are compared inside stacking contexts, not globally.

title: Overflow and clipping
summary: Choose how oversized content scrolls or is clipped.
syntax:
.class { overflow: auto | hidden | clip | visible; }
.line { overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
rules: ellipsis needs constrained inline space plus overflow clipping and no wrapping.
Do not hide focus indicators or essential content; offer a way to view full text.

title: Pseudo-classes and focus
summary: Apply styles according to interaction state or structural position.
rules: Keep keyboard focus visible; hover-only feedback excludes keyboard and touch users.
Pseudo-classes select existing elements; pseudo-elements target generated or partial content.

title: Pseudo-elements
summary: Style generated boxes or specific portions of an element.
rules: before and after generally require content to generate a box.
Keep essential information in semantic HTML rather than CSS-generated content.

title: Media queries and responsive layouts
summary: Condition styles on viewport dimensions or user preferences.
syntax:
@media (min-width: length) { selector { property: value; } }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { selector { property: value; } }
rules: Start with a small-screen layout and add changes at content-driven breakpoints.
Media queries describe the environment, not the width of an individual component.

references.title: MDN: Media queries and responsive layouts

title: Container queries
summary: Adapt descendants to the size of an eligible ancestor container.
syntax:
.parent { container-type: inline-size; container-name: name; }
@container name (min-width: length) { .child { property: value; } }
rules: A size query needs a containment context on an ancestor.
The query styles descendants; it cannot size-query and style the same element against itself.

title: Custom properties and themes
summary: Name reusable values with custom properties and resolve them using var().
syntax:
:root { --token: value; }
.class { property: var(--token, fallback); }
rules: Unregistered custom properties inherit and their names are case-sensitive.
A var fallback handles a missing or invalid custom property, not every invalid resulting declaration.

title: Transitions and transforms
summary: Interpolate changing properties and transform boxes without reflowing surrounding content.
syntax:
.class { transition: property duration easing; transform: translateY(length) rotate(angle) scale(number); }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .class { transition: none; transform: none; } }
rules: A transition needs a property value change, such as a hover state.
Respect reduced-motion preferences and avoid animating every property by default.

title: Keyframe animation
summary: Define named keyframes and apply timed animation sequences.
syntax:
@keyframes name { from { property: value; } to { property: value; } }
.class { animation: name duration easing iteration-count; }
rules: Keyframes do not run until an animation references their name.
Provide reduced-motion alternatives and avoid distracting indefinite motion.

title: Bootstrap CSS customization
summary: Override Bootstrap 5.3 component custom properties after loading its CSS.
syntax: .custom-button { --bs-btn-bg: color; --bs-btn-border-color: color; --bs-btn-hover-bg: color; --bs-btn-hover-border-color: color; }
rules: Load overrides after Bootstrap 5.3 CSS and attach your class to the component.
Component-specific --bs-* variables differ; consult the component reference.
Test default, hover, focus, active, and disabled states and contrast.

title: Tailwind build and theme tokens
summary: Import Tailwind CSS 4 and expose design tokens to its utility generator.
syntax:
@import "tailwindcss";
@theme { --color-name: color; --font-name: family; }
rules: These directives require Tailwind 4 processing; browsers cannot expand them directly.
Theme namespaces determine utilities, such as --color-garden enabling bg-garden.
Generate CSS with @tailwindcss/cli or a supported integration and link the output.

references.title: Tailwind CSS 4: Tailwind build and theme tokens
